title.value: Who Controlled the Evidence? Question Answering for Disclosure Information Extraction
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Who Controlled the Evidence? Question Answering for Disclosure Information Extraction

extractions.description: The paper introduces a novel task, COIRelationExt, to identify relationships between sponsoring entities and research studies from disclosure statements. It presents a new annotated dataset and a Question Answering-based method (QA4COI) for entity recognition and relationship extraction.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on conflict of interest in research and does not directly address sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Conflict of interest (COI) disclosure statements provide rich information to support transparency and reduce bias in research.
